transcribed_question:
A What day does the Caudal Neuropore close
B How many Somites are formed at the end of week 4
main_question: What day does the caudal neuropore close?
main_explanation: The caudal (posterior) neuropore typically closes at approximately day 28 of embryonic development (about 3 days after the cranial neuropore closes on day 25).

supporting_question.question: How many pairs of somites are typically present in a human embryo at the end of the fourth week (day 28)?
supporting_question.explanation: By the end of the fourth week of development (day 28), approximately 28 to 30 pairs of somites have formed along the neuraxis of the embryo.
